verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents running multiple sessions side by side, running multiple tasks in parallel on the web, and reviewing diffs visually, so a developer can run concurrent attempts. Its multi-agent feature splits a task into different parts and merges them, which is a different thing from running alternative attempts of the same task. Missing for 10: a documented way to run several attempts of the same task, any built-in comparison of those attempts before choosing a winner, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
